hints.title: Degrees per Minute and Hour
hints.text: The minute hand moves 360 / 60 = 6 degrees per minute. The hour hand moves 360 / 12 = 30 degrees per hour, plus 0.5 degrees per minute.

hints.title: Compute Exact Angles
hints.text: Minute angle = minutes * 6. Hour angle = (hour % 12) * 30 + minutes * 0.5.

hints.title: Absolute Difference and Reflex Angle
hints.text: Find diff = abs(hour_angle - minute_angle). Return min(diff, 360 - diff).
